description: Stairville LED Bar 240/8 RGB (240 LEDs in 8 segments), also the Varytec Giga Bar Pix 8 RGB and Giga Bar Frost Pix 8 RGB (144 SMD LEDs in 8 segments; the same four modes and the same channel tables). Modes: 2CH, 3CH, 5CH, 24CH; 24CH is the default. Generated from the Open Fixture Library (MIT licence, stairville/led-bar-240-8 at commit d9d675e) and checked against the manual.

modes.name: 2CH
modes.description: Programs (off), Show Speed (off). PitchControl can't change the light in this mode (no colour or dimmer channel); it is listed for addressing.

_note: Generated by tools/fixture_library.py (item 50). Corrections from the manual: 5CH Strobe: the manual prints 0..255 as strobe, increasing speed, with no open range (OFL says 0..2 open); open stays 0.
